title: Prevention of Falls and Injurious Falls Among Elderly People
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to describe and analyse the effects of multifactorial trial on the incidence of falls and injurious falls and on different risk factors of falling among the home-dwelling aged.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 65 years of age or older
* home-dweller
* having fallen at least once during the previous 12 months
* at least moderate cognitive abilities (MMSE over 17)
* able to walk 10 metres independently

Exclusion Criteria:

* MMSE under 17
